tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies API keys and connectivity.

tools.name: file-to-markdown
tools.description: Convert a file to text/Markdown (synchronous). Best for DIGITAL documents: PDFs with a real text layer and Word .docx are extracted exactly and instantly. For scans, photos, handwriting, stamps or ID cards, if you can see images use pdf-to-images instead and read the pages yourself — local OCR (used here as a fallback) is slower and less reliable. Use file-to-markdown-async for long-running jobs.

inputPath.description: Path to the file to convert

outputPath.description: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .md extension)

chunkSize.description: Pages per chunk for large PDFs (default: 10). Only used for PDFs >3MB

maxRetries.description: Maximum retries per chunk if processing fails (default: 3)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds per chunk (default: 120000 for chunks, 180000 for direct processing)

tools.name: file-to-markdown-async
tools.description: Convert a file to Markdown asynchronously (non-blocking). Supports PDF, Word .docx, and images (png/jpg/tiff/webp/gif/bmp). Returns a job ID immediately. Use get-job-status to check progress. For scans/photos/handwriting prefer pdf-to-images if you can see images.

inputPath.description: Path to the file to convert

outputPath.description: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .md extension)

chunkSize.description: Pages per chunk for large PDFs (default: 10)

maxRetries.description: Maximum retries per chunk if processing fails (default: 3)

tools.name: get-job-status
tools.description: Get the status of an async job. Returns current progress, status, and results when completed.

jobId.description: The job ID returned by file-to-markdown-async

tools.name: list-jobs
tools.description: List all jobs with optional filters. Useful for checking active jobs or recent completions.

status.description: Filter by status: queued, processing, completed, failed, cancelled

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return (default: 20)

tools.name: cancel-job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or processing job. Cannot cancel completed/failed jobs.

tools.name: audio-to-text
tools.description: Transcribe audio files to text using OpenAI Whisper API. Supports .m4a, .mp3, .wav, .ogg, .webm, .opus and other audio formats.

inputPath.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe

language.description: Optional: Language code (e.g., 'es' for Spanish, 'en' for English). Defaults to 'es' (Spanish) to prevent auto-detection from misidentifying Spanish as Catalan/Galician/Portuguese.

tools.name: svg-to-png
tools.description: Convert SVG files to PNG with optional width/height constraints

inputPath.description: Path to the SVG file to convert

outputPath.description: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .png extension)

tools.name: ocr-extract
tools.description: FALLBACK ONLY — local OCR (tesseract.js) of an image or PDF. If you can see images, use pdf-to-images instead: reading the pages with vision is faster and far more accurate on scans, handwriting, pen corrections and stamps. Use this only when images are reported as not shown (model without vision). Returns per-page confidence scores and low-confidence word markers. Supports: png, jpg, jpeg, tiff, webp, gif, bmp, pdf.

inputPath.description: Path to the image or PDF file

pages.description: Pages to process, e.g. '1-3,5' (default: all). Only for PDFs.

tools.name: pdf-to-images
tools.description: Show a PDF or an image file to YOU (the model) as images in your context, so you can read it with vision — scans, handwriting, pen corrections, stamps, ID cards, forms. Each PDF page is rendered in colour and attached to the result like an image the user pasted in chat. Use it whenever you need to actually look at a document (e.g. a PDF downloaded from an email); prefer it over ocr-extract when you can see images, and fall back to ocr-extract if the images are reported as not shown. Supports pdf, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, tiff, bmp. Max 10 pages per call — use `pages` for the rest.

inputPath.description: Path to the PDF or image file (e.g. /workspace/inbox/acta.pdf)

pages.description: PDF pages to show, e.g. '1-3,5' (default: the first 10). Ignored for images.

dpi.description: PDF render resolution (default 150; 200 for small print). Ignored for images.

maxDimension.description: Longest side of each attached image in px (default 1568, 512–2048).

autoRotate.description: Straighten sideways/upside-down pages (scanned IDs…) before attaching them (default true). Upright pages cost one quick check; only rotated ones take longer.
